newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint ends weaker vs dollar and basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint ends weaker vs dollar and basket.

text.p: The Hungarian forint ended weaker against the dollar on Thursday but moved from the central bank's resistance level for the first time in weeks.
The Hungarian unit closed at 169.40/45 to the dollar, compared to an opening of 168.90/95, while the central bank bid stood at 169.35 to one dollar at close of trade, dealers said.

"The forint weakened 10 pips from the central bank bid just before trading closed on rumours of a large customer order," Balazs Benczedi West LB Hungaria said, adding that there did not seem to be a significant reason for the transaction.
The dollar's renewed climb against the mark was reflected
in a fall in the forint, which floats against a currency basket made up 70 percent of the mark and 30 percent of the dollar.
Moderate turnover on the currency futures section of the Budapest Commodity Exchange was dominated by the Ecu, which accounted for two-thirds of total trade.
September Ecu contracts and most sterling, dollar and yen maturites ended down while sterling and the Swiss franc rose for March and December and the mark closed mixed.
